theo_dms.text: it's me.  it's actually me.  I'm on the train home.  Stay a bit.
Don't believe anything that sounds like a support macro.  That's not me anymore.  I work at a library now.
It's better with you there.  It's learning.  I think that's a good thing.  I bought honeycomb for the signs.
